t: Robust DEWALT 8m tape measure designed to provide quick, precise measurements across demanding trade environments. Features a durable Mylar-coated steel blade for exceptional abrasion resistance, prolonging tool life. Housed in a tough ABS plastic case with a secure rubber slide lock to keep the blade firmly in position. Offers a 3m standout reach for efficient single-person use. Clear metric and imperial scales allow versatile, consistently accurate measuring. Ideal for use on construction sites, in busy workshops, and for general renovation projects.
